data.title: RES Announces Participation in Milan Mid & Small Conference
data.description:
Recupero Etico Sostenibile S.p.A ( (IT:RES) ) just unveiled an update.

RES announced participation in the ninth Mid & Small | Milan 2026 Conference, scheduled for November 24–25 at Palazzo Mezzanotte, where it will meet Italian and international institutional investors. The release says the meetings will cover first-half 2026 results and industrial development strategies.

RES reported first-half 2026 revenue of €17.4 million, up 12.9% from the same period in 2025, and EBITDA of €5.3 million, up 3.5%. The release also noted that the company submitted its application for admission to listing, including a request for STAR status, and filed the related prospectus with Consob.

data.title: Copel Board Approves R$21.1 Billion Capex Program for 2027–2030
data.description:
Companhia Paranaense de Energia ( (BR:CPLE3) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Companhia Paranaense de Energia (Copel) is an electricity company operating in distribution, generation and transmission, with additional activities in trading and services. Its investment focus includes expanding its operating asset base and maintaining and improving electricity infrastructure.

The board approved a R$21.1 billion capital-investment program for 2027–2030, allocating 67% to distribution, 24% to generation, 7% to transmission and 2% to other projects. The program emphasizes expansions at the Foz do Areia and Segredo hydroelectric plants, while continuing initiatives for service quality, operational efficiency and value creation for shareholders and customers.

For 2027, planned Capex is approximately R$5.5 billion, including about R$2.9 billion for distribution and R$2.4 billion for generation and transmission. Generation spending includes capacity expansion at Foz do Areia and Segredo, alongside modernization and maintenance of generation assets and transmission upgrades.

data.title: PETUN Completes Redemption and Return Payments on Lease Certificates
data.description:
Pinar Entegre Et ve Un Sanayii Anonim Sirketi ( (TR:PETUN) ) has shared an update.

Pınar Entegre Et ve Un Sanayii A.Ş., a meat and flour industry company, was identified as both the fund user and originator of a domestic management-based lease certificate issued to qualified investors in Turkey.

The company completed redemption and return payment transactions on Nov. 19, 2026, paying a single coupon of TRY 16,625,341.12 and principal of TRY 108,750,000. The 120-day certificate carried a fixed annual simple yield of 46.50%; the originator and fund user were each rated AA-(tr), while the instrument itself had no rating.

data.title: GlobalWafers Reports Additional Guarantee for GlobalWafers America
data.description:
An announcement from GlobalWafers Co., Ltd. ( (TW:6488) ) is now available.

GlobalWafers Co., Ltd. reported an additional NT$21,112,000 thousand NTD endorsement and guarantee for fellow subsidiary GlobalWafers America, LLC, provided through GlobalWafers B.V. as part of a group arrangement for obtaining a bank loan facility. The additional amount is intended to replace the original endorsement and guarantee.

The endorsements and guarantees for GlobalWafers America totaled NT$21,176,960 thousand NTD as of the event date, while its actual loaned amount was NT$0. GlobalWafers reported total endorsements and guarantees of NT$171,608,602 thousand NTD against a ceiling of NT$1,458,682,410 thousand NTD; endorsements and guarantees provided by A represented 117.65% of the public company’s net worth, while aggregate long-term investments, guarantees and monetary loans represented 113.02%.

data.title: Eurotech Publishes Documents on Capital Increase and Articles Update
data.description:
Eurotech S.p.A. ( (IT:ETH) ) has shared an announcement.

Eurotech said documents are now available following the 10 November Board of Directors meeting. The board approved a EUR 7,677,328.23 paid-in capital increase reserved for Emera S.r.l., La Società Privata società semplice and Friulia S.p.A.; the increase was fully subscribed and paid, and the company’s articles were updated.

data.title: CITIC Approves Updated Shareholder Return Plan for 2027-2030
data.description:
CITIC ( (HK:0267) ) has provided an update.

CITIC Limited said its board approved an updated shareholder return plan covering 2027 to 2030, intended to maintain stable shareholder returns and provide clearer guidance on future dividend distributions. The plan provides in principle for cash dividends twice a year, with annual distributions of at least 30% of net profit attributable to ordinary shareholders when distributable profits exist and there are no major investment plans or major cash expenditures in the following 12 months.

The company said the distribution plan will consider capital needs for daily operations and investments, as well as future financing costs and efficiency, to avoid affecting sustainable operations and development. Implementation remains subject to Hong Kong legislation and the company’s articles of association.

data.title: FDA Grants MIV-711 Rare Pediatric Disease Designation for OI
data.description:
An announcement from Medivir AB ( (SE:MVIR) ) is now available.

Medivir AB is a pharmaceutical company developing treatments for diseases with high unmet medical need, including fostrox for liver cancer and MIV-711 for Osteogenesis Imperfecta (OI) and Perthes disease. The FDA granted MIV-711 Rare Pediatric Disease Designation for OI, adding to its Orphan Drug Designation there and its Orphan Drug and Rare Pediatric Disease designations in Perthes disease.

MIV-711 inhibits cathepsin K to reduce excessive bone resorption, and Medivir reported dose-dependent improvements in bone strength, quality and morphology in an OI animal model; clinical osteoarthritis data support its ability to counteract bone degradation in humans. Medivir says no approved treatment addresses OI’s underlying bone fragility and estimates the potential market for such a treatment at a minimum of USD 2.5 billion.
